alerts.headline: IMD orange: extremely heavy rain Bhagirathi catchment
alerts.detail: 72 mm / 3 h recorded at Maneri AWS. Flash-flood guidance remains in force until 10:00 IST.

alerts.headline: IMD red upgrade + high freeze line
alerts.detail: Rain turning to wet snow above 2,600 m. Slope saturation likely to trigger further debris flows on NH-34.

alerts.headline: CWC: Bhagirathi still above danger at Maneri
alerts.detail: Night-time drop of 0.4 m only. Gangotri highway not recommended after dusk; icing on Sukki–Harsil.
